customManagers.description: Track the Wrangler major pinned in the dry-run job's `npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run`. This job runs only on pull requests. The deploy job uses cloudflare/wrangler-action, and this pin does not change it. It is invoked via npx, so it is not a package.json dependency and neither the npm nor github-actions manager sees it. Renovate opens a PR when a new Wrangler major ships, so you can review it.

packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on the 6.x major (still take 6.x minor/patch). TS 7 is the ground-up native (Go port) compiler; our toolchain isn't ready — typescript-eslint's latest still caps its peer at typescript <6.1.0, so `eslint .` breaks under TS 7. Re-enable (drop this rule) once typescript-eslint publishes a release whose typescript peer range includes 7.x.
